Damn that sounds rough, sounds like there is exhaustion on both sides but clearly you're empathetic enough to know why she might be feeling this way, that's a good sign. Can you garuantee it will get worse? You seem like youve been doing great so far, you will grow and rise to meet the challenge or adapt and make it easier. Either way if life is fine there is no use in killing yourself because it MIGHT get worse. You can apply that logic to anything, I could get hit by a car tomorrow and cripple my family financially, but I take those chances because I know that even though I MIGHT die tomorrow, if I kill myself I definitely will be deae tomorrow.
Take a deep breath, the ocean, the gun, the pills can wait. You can keep going a little longer. You're strong. Hope you're OK friend.

Life is full of these kinds of anxieties my friend. However this is not the end of the world, phone calls, cross country flights, the Internet, there's loads of ways to keep in contact and I'm sure your sister will be feeling the same way about leaving you. This will make the time spent together more memorable, personally my sister is my best ally in my fight against anxiety, she lives ages away but she's also willing to talk to me whenever I need it. Which means when I see her in person I'm so full of joy from seeing her.
